{{Quote|All shipboard battle droids are now at Alert Status 1. Terminate the Jedi on sight.|Trade Federation Battle Droid's become aware of the Jedi's presence aboard the Saak'ak|<ref name="Star Wars: Obi-Wan">[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']]</ref>}}
'''Alert Status 1''' was a combat alert status in use by [[Battle droid/Legends|Battle droid]] personnel aboard the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Battleship/Legends|Battleship]] [[Saak'ak/Legends|Saak'ak]]. During the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], it was declared when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] were detected in the ship air ducts after having escaped from the conference room when [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] ordered for them to be executed.
